dedupe_keys.name: field observations of agricultural water infrastructure and crop types in the western bahia cerrado

description: Field Observations of Agricultural Water Infrastructure and Crop Types in the Western Bahia Cerrado is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Antonio Fonseca, Gustavo de L. T. Oliveira (Clark University). This dataset contains geolocated field observations collected in Western Bahia, Brazil, a key region for agricultural expansion in the Cerrado biome. The data provides ground truth points used to validate remote sensing classifications of land use and land cover, with a specific focus on irrigated agriculture and water infrastructure. Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
